recipes.name: Behili palov
recipes.subtitle: The quince plot twist
recipes.description: Fragrant golden quince nestled into the zirvak before the rice.

recipes.name: To‘y oshi
recipes.subtitle: A wedding for one fly

recipes.name: Bedana palov

ingredients.name: Chickpeas
ingredients.note: Pre-soaked chickpeas, ready for the qazan.

ingredients.name: Raisins
ingredients.note: Little sweet pockets among the golden grains.

ingredients.name: Quail eggs
ingredients.note: Already boiled and peeled; added after steaming.

ingredients.name: Qazi

ingredients.name: Stuffed quail
